issues: Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Delivery performance was poor across the region, with high rider waiting times, missing items and insufficient photographic evidence attached to claims.
Region-wide (North England & Midlands): The new loyalty system is letting customers stack multiple vouchers on a single tab, and several sites reported display and redemption problems.
Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Takeaway packaging from China has still not arrived and sites are waiting on it for delivery presentation.
Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Event food spend continues to sit within site food cost, but the food cost budget will be increased for sites running B2B events.
Delivery prep and rider waiting times increased, with rejected orders, a missing item and negative delivery reviews.
Inaccurate delivery orders were sent out, with several disputes raised and one order rejected.
The loyalty app shows several vouchers as redeemable at once for customers migrated from the old scheme, and the free ramen discount auto-applies to the highest priced ramen rather than the lowest.
Kobas integration issue - a discounted voucher price reverts to the original price when a guest part pays or moves the item to a tab, so redemption cannot be tracked at the back end.
Onboarding is incomplete for one new starter and onboarding documents are outstanding for another due to start in early September.
The old ice machine still needs removing for recycling and the quoted disposal cost was considered too high.

Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Apply the free ramen discount to the lowest priced ramen on the tab - Owner: M9 (01/09/2026)
Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Send photos of any loyalty system difficulty to the morning marketing group chat so the back end settings can be investigated - Owner: M9 (01/09/2026)

Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Capture photographic evidence for every delivery claim and make sure a manager actively monitors the delivery station and driver handovers - Owner: M9 (01/09/2026)
Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Report delivery technical faults such as tickets failing to print immediately, as the evidence is lost after a day - Owner: M9 (01/09/2026)
Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Schedule an additional staff member for bank holiday Monday to handle the increased traffic - Owner: M9 (31/08/2026)
Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Verify and secure sufficient stock levels for the bank holiday - Owner: M9 (31/08/2026)
Region-wide (North England & Midlands): Confirm with marketing whether multiple voucher redemption can be limited by setting, and report back to the sites - Owner: Amy Tang (01/09/2026)
Send a screenshot of the loyalty voucher display issue to the marketing group chat - Owner: M9 (01/09/2026)
Submit claims for the rejected and missing delivery orders using the available photographs - Owner: M9 (01/09/2026)
Reply to the negative delivery reviews, issue credit notes and invite the customers back - Owner: M9 (01/09/2026)
Reduce delivery prep time to meet the target and keep monitoring inaccurate orders through the week - Owner: M9 (01/09/2026)
